cases.name: X1 a partner stays on its pinned release and snapshot while a new release and new settings arrive

detail.note: release and configuration are pinned by the same rule, and neither moved under it

cases.name: X2 a failed evidence write degrades the scope without touching the outcome or losing the snapshot

detail.note: successful work must not become failed work because a disk write failed

cases.name: X3 a cross-process owner registered without liveness holds its snapshot, and cleanup now says so

detail.note: a diagnostic, not a verdict: an in-process owner ending at Dispose appears here legitimately

cases.name: X4 negative control: with a liveness-capable owner the same snapshot IS reclaimed

detail.note: same sequence, one difference: the owner could be asked

cases.name: X5a a refused runtime leaves the committed pair untouched, and admissions still see it

detail.note: the pair is published only after both halves succeed, so a refusal is a non-event

cases.name: X5b a settings commit failure after the runtime half leaves the previous pair usable

detail.note: publication never happened, so there is no rollback step that could itself fail

cases.name: X5c an admission held at the boundary observes one whole pair, never a mixture

detail.note: admission and publication share one critical section, so there is no halfway state

cases.name: X5d mutation control: reading the halves separately admits a pair that was never current

detail.note: this is what BeginFromSelection exists to prevent; it fails here on purpose

cases.name: X6 after a settings-only activation through the coordinator, admission lands on a live snapshot

detail.note: the rule is that any activation republishes the pair, so selected and pinned are equal

cases.name: X7 a stale selection no longer admits under a reclaimed snapshot, because selected is retained

detail.note: was reproducible until the selected-snapshot reason landed; kept as the acceptance case

cases.name: X8 a cleanup inside the commit window no longer reclaims the snapshot the selection names

detail.note: the handoff @kirillkrylov required: the selection retains its snapshot across admission

cases.name: X10 mutation control: ignoring the selected-snapshot reason reopens the window

detail.note: observed failing the guarantee, not merely applied

cases.name: X9 the ledger already knows the answer cleanup needs: the snapshot was still selected

detail.note: one ownership reason short: Cleanup consults held and pinned and retained, not selected
